races.name: Julie Satterley Waving Goodbye To 49 Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Ja Klipdrift
runners_data.spotlight: 4,000euros yearling; third foal; dam German 7f/1m winner, sister to useful 2m-2m2f hurdle/chase winner Jan Maat, half-sister to 7f Listed winner Japan; probably best watched on debut.

runners_data.name: La Fille Friday
runners_data.spotlight: First foal; dam unraced half-sister to useful 2m hurdle winner Aristo Du Plessis, out of maiden sister to French 2m1f chase winner Babati; best watched on this racecourse debut.

runners_data.name: Machete Beach
runners_data.spotlight: Lightly raced 5yo who scored twice on Flat over 1m2f in 2024 for Harry Charlton; returned from a 359-day break to open his account over hurdles in a weak Hereford maiden (2m, good) 25 days ago; has clearly had issues but possesses plenty of talent and should go close.

runners_data.name: Maskarvel
runners_data.comment: Ran well in defeat at Aintree yesterday; big player if making a quick reappearance
runners_data.spotlight: Made the frame in all three Irish bumpers last year and launched hurdling career with three very encouraging runs for new stable, most recently when clear second at Aintree (2m1f, good) 15 days ago; looks sure to run well.

runners_data.name: Usyk
runners_data.spotlight: Displayed clear promise when making the frame in a couple of bumpers last summer, but below that form when sixth of seven in a similar event at Worcester (2m, good; favourite) in September; makes hurdling debut and market will be best guide to his chance.

runners_data.name: At Sunrise
runners_data.comment: Pulled up when 300-1 for hurdling debut at Hereford (2m3f) in December
runners_data.spotlight: Has shown just modest form in a couple of bumpers and two hurdle starts; easy to dismiss.

runners_data.name: Take The Boat
runners_data.comment: In good form since upped to middle distances this year; fair mark if drop to 1m2f is okay
runners_data.spotlight: Four wins on AW Flat over 7f-1m4f at a modest level; interesting how she takes to this new discipline; may be one to fight out minor honours.

races.name: Happy 70th Birthday Rich Wilding Mares' Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Stellarmasterpiece
runners_data.comment: Loves it here and kept on for 1m6f third here last time; every chance she'll be in the mix
runners_data.spotlight: Has won once on the Flat in Poland and four times at Catterick (1m4f), but the best she has been able to muster in seven runs over hurdles is when third of nine finishers at Doncaster (2m, good to soft) in November; interesting that Sean Bowen rides for the first time.

runners_data.name: Kottayam
runners_data.spotlight: Showed promise when placed a couple of times last year for Patrick Neville but pulled up in a couple of handicaps for Dylan Cunha and last of ten to complete on stable debut at Ludlow (2m5f, good) last month after six-month break; drops back in trip and tongue-tie is back on along with first-time cheekpieces; major revival required.

runners_data.name: Little Lady Lucy
runners_data.spotlight: Relished the drop in trip and front-running tactics when getting off the mark in this sphere at Wincanton (1m7f, good; 25-1) last month; showed that was no fluke when following up at Taunton (2m, good) ten days later; 8lb higher here but this track should play to her strengths and looks the one to beat.

runners_data.name: Noble Miss
runners_data.spotlight: Won a bumper for Rae Guest but has no form claims on what she's achieved over hurdles, including three handicaps at Fakenham; first-time blinkers are now applied along with hood.

runners_data.name: Blue Siam
runners_data.comment: Modest Flat maiden and insufficient promise in her two races over hurdles to consider
runners_data.spotlight: Modest Flat maiden and only minor promise in her three races over hurdles; she still has time on her side, though, and she swaps a hood for cheekpieces on her handicap debut.

runners_data.name: Liasse d'Argent
runners_data.comment: Showed some ability at Stratford last month but not enough to suggest she'll threaten here
runners_data.spotlight: Has shown just modest form so far; sports first-time tongue-tie on handicap debut and improvement required.

runners_data.name: Burgeon
runners_data.spotlight: Has shown little in four hurdle starts, including on handicap debut when pulled up at Warwick (2m5f, good) 26 days ago; sports first-time tongue-tie and cheekpieces, and they need to have an impact.

runners_data.name: For Love Of Beauty
runners_data.comment: Had wind op before pulled up on yard debut in Huntingdon maiden latest; handicap debutant
runners_data.spotlight: Has shown only poor form in four runs over hurdles, including when fifth of six finishers at Taunton (2m, good) last month on her handicap debut.

races.name: Julie Satterley 50th Birthday Celebration Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: In The Air
runners_data.spotlight: Won five over hurdles for previous yards and three over fences last term for current trainer; may have needed the run when seventh of eight finishers at Chepstow (2m, good to soft) last month after six-month layoff but probably needs to come down the weights.

runners_data.name: Forget The Way
runners_data.comment: Won at Huntingdon in November and not beaten far in a better race there subsequently.
runners_data.spotlight: Has three wins in this sphere and made a solid return when runner-up at Warwick (2m, good) ten days ago following a six-month break; should be thereabouts.

runners_data.name: Half A Chance
runners_data.comment: Made a promising debut over fences when fourth at Wexford 16 days ago.
runners_data.spotlight: Irish challenger whose sole success came in a Limerick maiden on his hurdles debut in May 2024; placed five times last term and returns to this discipline after a couple of unsuccessful runs over fences this month; win record is offputting.

runners_data.name: Hope Rising
runners_data.comment: Three wins in early part of last season; off since refusing to race in October; new trip
runners_data.spotlight: Won three in her first season over hurdles last term and may not have got home when third of five at Huntingdon (2m3f, good) on her return to action 23 days ago; should be sharper for the run and holds claims.

runners_data.name: Juan Bermudez
runners_data.comment: Returned to form with close second at favourite track Stratford last month
runners_data.spotlight: All three wins over hurdles have been over C&D; returned to form when beaten a neck over C&D (good) last month and filled the same position at Aintree (2m1f, good) 15 days ago; is a major force around here and must come into the reckoning.

runners_data.name: Ivane
runners_data.comment: Ex-Irish; four wins for James Owen, including two over fences here; this going not ideal
runners_data.spotlight: Successful over fences (twice) and hurdles last term; went off the boil on his last two runs early on this year and is 7lb higher than his last winning mark; looks to need to come down the weights.

runners_data.name: Yes Day
runners_data.spotlight: Both wins over fences came in March 2025; his season never took off last term and he arrives here on a career-low mark (11lb below last win); first-time blinkers replace cheekpieces; needs to show more.

runners_data.name: Imperial Alex
runners_data.comment: Soundly beaten in his last three races, disappointingly so at Warwick last time
runners_data.spotlight: Four-times winning chaser over around 3m; returned to his best when beaten a neck at Ffos Las (3m, good) 25 days ago with 15l back to the third; nudged up 4lb but holds claims if he gets home over this marathon trip.

runners_data.name: Esperti
runners_data.spotlight: Has returned to form of late and gained his fifth chase success, at Ffos Las (3m, good) last month; there was no disgrace in finishing second to a resurgent Tommy Beau at Fakenham (3m5f, good) this month and he holds strong claims while in this form.

runners_data.name: Ballynaheer
runners_data.spotlight: Landed his fourth win over fences, at Market Rasen (3m, good) last month but below his best at Fontwell since; is the type to bounce back and he should get the trip (has won over 3m2f).

races.name: Owen Thomas Memorial Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: In This World
runners_data.comment: Won twice for Dan Skelton but opposable on what he's shown in last four races
runners_data.spotlight: Won twice for the Skeltons; showed his best form for his current yard when fifth of eight at Warwick (2m, good) 26 days ago; his mark continues to drop and he should find another opening at some point.

runners_data.name: Delpotro
runners_data.comment: Returned from break to finish 3rd at Plumpton; this front-runner could be tough to reel in
runners_data.spotlight: Front-runner whose two wins last year came at Sedgefield when making all; his suspect stamina gave out in a match at Hereford (2m5f, good) 18 days ago but this track back down in trip should play to his strengths; regular hood returns after being omitted last time.

runners_data.name: Bobbarelli
runners_data.comment: A dual winning pointer, he was a runner-up over hurdles at Warwick and Taunton this year.
runners_data.spotlight: A dual winning pointer, he was runner-up twice over hurdles this year but disappointed when beaten 20l over fences at Bangor (2m4f, good) last Saturday; drops back in trip and may be worth another chance.

runners_data.name: Turpin Gold
runners_data.comment: Has done well for this yard since returning from a long absence; 2nd off this mark latest
runners_data.spotlight: Four-times winning hurdler making a belated debut over fences after six-month break; hard to fancy unless there is a move in the market.

runners_data.name: Rocks Up Late
runners_data.spotlight: Won four times over fences last spring/summer but was beaten 25l at Lingfield (2m, good) when last seen in November; has had wind surgery since and is only 1lb higher than for his last success; must hold claims from good yard if ready to roll.

races.name: Happy 70th Birthday Steve Cotton Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Mix Of Clover
runners_data.spotlight: A summer jumper who mixes hurdling with chasing; won here over fences (2m5f, good) last October; returns from a six-month break and has never won following such an absence.

runners_data.name: Two To Tango
runners_data.comment: Consistent 8yo; recent Stratford winner who should have every chance off 4lb higher
runners_data.spotlight: After being placed 12 times he gained an overdue success around here (2m3f, good) in March; let down by his jumping at Warwick since but looks sure to be thereabouts.

runners_data.name: Gateau De Miel
runners_data.spotlight: His second success over fences came at this track (2m6f, good) last June; has been beaten in hunter chases/points since and makes stable debut; may be better suited by 3m but not out of this.

runners_data.name: Boom Boom
runners_data.spotlight: Won here over 2m1f (good) and an extended 2m3f (good to firm) last summer; subsequently lost his form in three runs; hard to gauge how he will run after a layoff but he would come into this if back on song.

runners_data.name: Lacrima
runners_data.spotlight: Won four times when trained in France last year but has been beaten 64l and 60l on his two starts in Britain; steps up in trip and blinkers worn last time are left off; hard to fancy until he shows a bit of form.

races.name: Sun Racing Summer Jumps Championship Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Shesonnet
runners_data.comment: Needs to bounce back from pulling up latest and opening mark doesn't look generous.
runners_data.spotlight: Got off the mark up in trip at Warwick (2m5f, good; 33-1) 26 days ago on her handicap debut; lightly raced and there should be more to come from her.

runners_data.name: Tao Enki
runners_data.comment: Looks on stiff mark, despite 4lb drop, judged on his recent handicap debut; headgear now.
runners_data.spotlight: 0-7 but ran his best race to date when runner-up at Hereford (2m, good) 25 days ago in first-time cheekpieces (retained); steps up in trip but knocking on the door and should go close.

runners_data.name: Miss Tiara
runners_data.comment: Signs in her last two races that she's found her level; drops back from 3m
runners_data.spotlight: Had three runs since a wind operation; signs in her last two races that she's found her level, beaten under 7l in 3m handicaps at Taunton; this trip might be a better fit; considered.

runners_data.name: Lion Of The Desert
runners_data.comment: Back over this trip he's gone back-to-back in course handicaps; up 5lb for last time
runners_data.spotlight: Ex-Irish; recorded back-to-back wins at Ffos Las (2m4f, good) recently; maintained his good level of form when third of five back there ten days ago; must come into this if he can replicate his form here.

runners_data.name: Great d'Ange
runners_data.comment: Visor joins regular tongue-tie but he's not easy to recommend at present
runners_data.spotlight: Has four wins over fences but yet to score in this sphere; has shown nothing in his three runs for current yard.

runners_data.name: Masonbrook Meadow
runners_data.spotlight: Got off the mark at the 27th attempt under rules at Exeter (2m, good to firm) last October; ran her best since when runner-up at Fakenham (2m7f, good) 26 days ago; her versatility distance-wise holds her in good stead but her win-record is off-putting.

runners_data.name: Roxboro River
runners_data.comment: Stayed well when winning over 2m6f at Stratford last summer, weak Irish form
runners_data.spotlight: Got off the mark over hurdles when winning over C&D (good to firm) last July off 1lb lower; hasn't been placed since but dangerous to dismiss.

runners_data.name: Parikarma
runners_data.spotlight: Has three wins over hurdles but she has been below her best since returning from a 436-day break in February; down to a career-low mark in this sphere but best watched for now.

runners_data.name: American Trio
runners_data.spotlight: 0-8 in points and showed little in first two starts for this yard in March; landed a gamble when dropped into a seller at Exeter (2m2f, good) last month in first-time visor (retained since); not disgraced when second of three at Huntingdon (2m4f, good to firm) on his handicap debut 11 days ago and should run well.

runners_data.name: Shes All Pride
runners_data.comment: Improved form when third at Stratford; 3lb out of the weights again but she's in this mix
runners_data.spotlight: Showed first form over hurdles when third of nine over C&D (good) in March on her handicap debut; failed to replicate that effort at Ludlow since.
